patchwork.config.title: Patchwork Settings
patchwork.config.restart: Restart the game or server to apply changes.
patchwork.config.multiplayer: Multiplayer gameplay is controlled by the server's config.
patchwork.config.spider_distance_order: Spider web minimum distance must not exceed maximum distance.
patchwork.config.animalDroppedFood.summa: Animals seek and eat dropped breeding food.
patchwork.config.animalDroppedFood.descr: Allow animals to seek dropped food, breed, and grow babies when mobGriefing is enabled. Configure search radius, eating distance, timing, and movement speed below.
patchwork.config.slimeCloudEffectAmplifi: Slime cloud slowness amplifier (0 = level I)
patchwork.config.witherEasyHealth: Easy and Peaceful Wither maximum health (HP)
patchwork.config.flyingSpeedEffectMultip: Flying speed bonus per Speed effect level
Wither health follows the configured difficulty values.
Scale the Wither's maximum health with difficulty. Existing Withers keep their health percentage when difficulty changes. Turning this off does not reset already saved Wither health.
patchwork.config.witherBirthExplosion.su: Add configurable damage to the birth explosion.
patchwork.config.witherBirthExplosion.de: Increase the Wither's birth explosion entity damage by the configured bonus without changing its radius, blocks, or knockback. Default bonus: 3 HP.
patchwork.config.chainmailRecipes.summar: Craft all four pieces with iron chains.
patchwork.config.chainmailRecipes.descri: Enable the four chainmail armor crafting recipes and their recipe-book unlock advancements. Disable to remove Patchwork's recipes from the next game or server start.
patchwork.config.wolfBanners.summary: Equip and display banners on owned wolves.
patchwork.config.wolfBanners.description: Allow owners to equip and remove banners on tamed wolves. Your client also uses this setting to render banners. Disabling it does not remove banners already equipped.
patchwork.config.ownerSweepProtection.su: Prevent indirect owner sweeps hitting pets.
patchwork.config.ownerSweepProtection.de: Exclude owned tamed wolves and cats from the indirect damage, knockback, and effects of their owner's sword sweep. Direct hits remain possible.
patchwork.config.shulkerDyeing.summary: Use dye to recolor living shulkers.
patchwork.config.shulkerDyeing.descripti: Right-click a living shulker with dye to set its vanilla color, consuming one dye when the color changes (except with infinite materials).
patchwork.config.throwableSlimeballs.sum: Throw slimeballs with configurable damage and effects.
patchwork.config.throwableSlimeballs.des: Throw slimeballs to damage and slow targets, or heal and speed up Slimes. Configure damage, healing, duration, amplifier, and cooldown below. Defaults: 1 HP, 60-tick level I effects, 20-tick cooldown.
patchwork.config.callHornRecall.summary: Recall your seated pets with the Call horn.
patchwork.config.callHornRecall.descript: Using the Call goat horn recalls your nearby sitting tamed pets to safe spots near you; other goat horns are unchanged. Controlled by the server.
patchwork.config.cauldronCleaning.summar: Clean colored wool, terracotta, and glass.
patchwork.config.cauldronCleaning.descri: Right-click a water cauldron with dyed wool, terracotta, or stained glass to return one block to white wool, plain terracotta, or plain glass, using one water level. Vanilla shulker-box washing remains available even when this is off.
patchwork.config.beesDefendFlowers.summa: Breaking flowers near occupied hives releases bees.
patchwork.config.beesDefendFlowers.descr: Breaking a flower within the configured radius of an occupied, unsmoked beehive or bee nest releases its bees. Default radius: four blocks. Smoke keeps bees calm.
patchwork.config.creeperChainReactions.s: OFF by default: Creeper blasts ignite other Creepers.
patchwork.config.creeperChainReactions.d: A Creeper damaged by another Creeper's explosion ignites its full fuse. Disabled by default because chain explosions can destroy more terrain.
patchwork.config.endermanDefense.summary: Hurt Endermen may place carried blocks as cover.
patchwork.config.endermanDefense.descrip: When damaged by a living attacker, an Enderman carrying a block may place it between them if the space is safe and mobGriefing is enabled. Configure the chance below; default: one in three.
patchwork.config.spiderWebs.summary: Chasing spiders occasionally place cobwebs at prey.
patchwork.config.spiderWebs.description: Chasing spiders attempt to place cobwebs at their prey's feet if space permits and mobGriefing is enabled. Distance, attempt interval, and chance are configurable. Defaults: 2-8 blocks, 100 ticks, 25 percent.
patchwork.config.throwableFireCharges.su: Launch fireballs with configurable flight and damage.
patchwork.config.throwableFireCharges.de: Throw regular or Soul Fire Charges without explosions. Damage, flight, clearance, and cooldown are configurable. Defaults: 2/3 HP, five blocks clearance, 30-tick cooldown. This switch controls player throwing, not Soul Golem attacks or block use. Soul projectile flight and damage settings also apply to Soul Golems and dispensers.
patchwork.config.slimeSplitClouds.summar: Large and medium Slimes leave a brief slowing cloud.
patchwork.config.slimeSplitClouds.descri: When a medium or large Slime dies and splits, it leaves slowing dust on solid ground without replacing blocks. Cloud size, lifetime, and effect amplifier are configurable. Defaults: 3x3 blocks, 100 ticks, Slowness II.
patchwork.config.breezeShockwave.summary: Melee hits cause a configurable gust.
patchwork.config.breezeShockwave.descrip: When a Breeze survives a melee hit, it pushes nearby entities. With mobGriefing enabled, it extinguishes campfires and optionally torches and lanterns. Configure radius, push, and cooldown below. Defaults: five blocks and 200 ticks.
patchwork.config.breezeTorchExtinguishin: Breeze gusts extinguish nearby torches and lanterns.

With Breeze melee shockwave and mobGriefing enabled, gusts extinguish torches and lanterns within the configured shockwave radius. Breaking them drops matching unlit items that can be placed or relit with a fire charge. Hanging, waterlogging, oxidation, and waxing are preserved. Waterlogged lanterns cannot be relit. Disabling does not remove existing unlit items or blocks.
patchwork.config.hoglinCharge.summary: Charging Hoglins launch victims into the air.
patchwork.config.hoglinCharge.descriptio: Adult Hoglins launch victims when sprinting or exceeding the configured speed threshold. Launch velocities, player collision damage, and the collision window are configurable. Defaults: 0.18 blocks/tick, 0.2 horizontal and 0.69 vertical velocity, 2 HP within 20 ticks. Normal hits remain unchanged.
patchwork.config.skeletonCover.summary: Nearby Skeletons seek cover while reloading.
patchwork.config.skeletonCover.descripti: When a player comes within the configured distance, a bow-wielding Skeleton may move behind an adjacent wall corner while reloading, then return to its clear position. Distance and movement speed are configurable; default distance: six blocks. Requires a path and nearby obstruction.
patchwork.config.potionCauldrons.summary: Pour potions into cauldrons to tip arrows.
patchwork.config.potionCauldrons.descrip: Pour a drinkable non-water potion into an empty cauldron for one potion level. Water cauldrons cannot accept potions. Matching potions refill it up to three levels. Glass bottles retrieve one potion level. Right-click with ordinary arrows or drop them inside to turn one arrow into a matching tipped arrow per potion level. Dropped stacks can consume multiple levels without respawning the converted item. Different potions do not mix. Disabling prevents filling, retrieval, or dipping; existing potion cauldrons remain placed.
patchwork.config.pumpkinLanterns.summary: Use a torch or soul torch on a carved pumpkin.
patchwork.config.pumpkinLanterns.descrip: Right-click a placed carved pumpkin with a torch to turn it into a Jack o'Lantern, or with a soul torch to turn it into a blue-flamed Soul Jack o'Lantern. Its facing is preserved and one torch is consumed except in creative mode. Turning this off disables the interaction, not already placed or collected lanterns.
patchwork.config.experienceClumping.summ: Merge nearby XP orbs and collect their full value.
patchwork.config.experienceClumping.desc: Experience awards create one orb. Once per second, orbs merge with others within 2 blocks while preserving all XP. Collect a merged orb's full value at once, including normal Mending repairs. Large values survive saving and reloading. Disable to restore vanilla spawning, merging, and pickup behavior.
patchwork.config.sweetBerryTrades.summar: Add a sweet-berry trade to wandering traders.
patchwork.config.sweetBerryTrades.descri: Wandering traders offer 6 sweet berries for 1 emerald. Applied to new trade lists after restart.
patchwork.config.elytraDyeing.summary: Dye Elytra with dyes in a crafting grid.
patchwork.config.elytraDyeing.descriptio: Enable the shapeless Elytra-and-dye recipe and dyed worn/item appearance. Existing dyed Elytra retain their color.
patchwork.config.stoneToolMaterials.summ: Use stone, cobblestone, or a mixture to craft stone tools.
patchwork.config.stoneToolMaterials.desc: Add regular stone to the vanilla stone tool material tag, allowing it to mix with cobblestone and other vanilla stone tool materials.
patchwork.config.playerHeadRecipe.summar: Craft a player head with leather and a carved pumpkin.
patchwork.config.playerHeadRecipe.descri: Enable the shaped recipe with a carved pumpkin in the center and eight leather around it.
patchwork.config.spiderCeilingClimbing.s: Spiders and cave spiders cling and crawl upside down on ceilings.
patchwork.config.spiderCeilingClimbing.d: Allow both spider types to cling to solid ceilings without gravity and traverse them.
patchwork.config.caveSpiderNausea.summar: Cave spider attacks have a 20% chance to cause Nausea.
patchwork.config.caveSpiderNausea.descri: Successful cave spider melee hits have a 20% chance to inflict Nausea for 5 seconds.
patchwork.config.loyalTridentVoidReturn: Loyal tridents return from the void
Loyalty tridents survive falling into the void and return to their owner.
Prevent void removal for Loyalty tridents with a valid owner so vanilla Loyalty return behavior can bring them back.
patchwork.config.patchworkAdvancements.d: Load Patchwork-specific advancement entries and award gameplay-triggered Patchwork advancements.
advancements.patchwork.iron_man.title: Iron Man
advancements.patchwork.iron_man.descript: Wear a full set of iron armor
advancements.patchwork.living_like_a_kin: Wear a full set of gold armor
advancements.patchwork.wrecked.title: Wrecked
advancements.patchwork.restored_to_color: Wash a dyed bundle in a water cauldron
advancements.patchwork.creature_comforts: Let an animal eat food you dropped
advancements.patchwork.let_there_be_ligh: Relight an unlit torch or lantern with a fire charge
advancements.patchwork.overpowered.title: Overpowered
patchwork.config.callHornRecallRadius.de: Maximum distance in blocks from which the Call goat horn recalls your sitting tamed pets. Enter an integer from 16 to 256; the server controls this in multiplayer.
